title: Change opens the Bill Invoices To window with its help line and Save
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, whose Bill Invoices To is saved as customer B in Edit Customer.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer A's page.
  2. Click "Change" beside "Bill Invoices To" on the left card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The left card shows "Bill Invoices To" with customer B's name and "Change".

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Bill Invoices To" opens.
  • It shows the line "New work orders and part sales for [customer A's name] will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."
  • It has a "Bill Invoices To" field showing customer B's name.
  • It has a "Save" button.

Words in square brackets in a message stand for the value they name, such as customer B's name exactly as it is saved; every other word of the message must match exactly.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12303 (Story 1, Saved default Bill To on the customer page)

  • S1-R3: “The window shows the help line "New work orders and part sales for [customer] will be billed to this customer. Existing ones don't change."”
  • S1-R4: “The window has a searchable "Bill Invoices To" field and a "Save" button.”
